title: Standards Engine A1 contract
description: Canonical typed contract for snapshot-bound navigation and read-only standards-change analysis.

state_machine.identity: AnalysisHandle is the sole A1 lifecycle identity and resolves exactly one immutable AnalysisState
state_machine.prepare: construct and normalize one immutable state, then project PendingResult or CompleteResult
state_machine.resolve: advance one immutable state with an authorized submission and project the normalized child state
state_machine.branching: different valid submissions against one state produce independent child states; no global supersession or mutable A1 head exists
state_machine.reuse: one optional prior AnalysisHandle supplies decisions that are retained only when their narrow dependencies remain valid
state_machine.completion: Only material unresolved requirements and obligations block completion; dormant dependency-valid decisions remain state authority.

x-standards-engine-invariants.authority: value must resolve exactly through the registered generic graph; each registered provider owns its identity contract and no lookup inference or fallback is permitted

x-standards-engine-invariants.resolved: unresolved_facts is empty when truth is true or false
x-standards-engine-invariants.unknown: unresolved_facts contains exactly the canonical material facts when truth is unknown

x-standards-engine-invariants.enum-values: values are required only for enum and enum-set facts
x-standards-engine-invariants.alias-resolution: aliases resolve before evaluation and conflicts are invalid
x-standards-engine-invariants.semantic-identity: semantic revision, value domain, meaning, context, answer, evidence and authorization contracts determine decision identity; aliases and prompt are lookup and display projections

x-standards-engine-invariants.projection: the value is an operation-shaped inspection of compiled relationship authority and is never an editable declaration
x-standards-engine-invariants.internal-boundary: repository declaration paths, compiled program internals, and dependency fingerprints are not public

x-standards-engine-invariants.modification: exactly one equal accepted and proposed ID
x-standards-engine-invariants.addition: no accepted ID and exactly one proposed ID
x-standards-engine-invariants.removal: exactly one accepted ID and no proposed ID
x-standards-engine-invariants.move: exactly one equal accepted and proposed ID; module identity determines same-module or cross-module graph selection
x-standards-engine-invariants.split: exactly one accepted ID and at least two distinct proposed IDs
x-standards-engine-invariants.merge: at least two distinct accepted IDs and exactly one proposed ID

x-standards-engine-invariants.addition: accepted digests and revision are null; proposed digests exist; proposed semantic revision is 1
x-standards-engine-invariants.removal: proposed digests and revision are null; accepted digests and revision exist
x-standards-engine-invariants.existing-policy: accepted and proposed accepted-authority sidecars retain the accepted semantic revision; a proposed increment exists only in the AnalysisRequest semantic overlay
x-standards-engine-invariants.structural-equality: may support representation-only-candidate but never proves semantic equivalence

x-standards-engine-projection.identity: handle is the projected state's AnalysisHandle

x-standards-engine-invariants.provider-registration: membership is resolved by this registered deterministic provider and never from an arbitrary caller list

x-standards-engine-invariants.coverage_set_equality: required_coverage_subjects equals certificate_subjects as sets and every certificate is current for the report authority view
x-standards-engine-invariants.fact_set_equality: required_fact_requirements equals observed_fact_requirements as sets and every observation is exact for the derived requirement
x-standards-engine-invariants.derived_truth: every Boolean is generated from current resolved state and cannot be caller-authored

x-standards-engine-projection.identity: handle is the projected state's AnalysisHandle

x-standards-engine-invariants.symlink: target and resolution are required; escaped resolution is valid only as inert content
x-standards-engine-invariants.gitlink: recorded gitlink and checked-out state are explicit; dirty nested content binds nested_snapshot
x-standards-engine-invariants.path: normalized repository-relative path; absolute paths, parent traversal, and normalization collisions are invalid
